  overwrite: false

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(facspseudocolor)
source(system.file("quarto", "_report-setup.R", package = "facspseudocolor"), local = TRUE)
analysis <- facs_report_input(params$config, params$analysis_rds)
style <- resolve_facs_appearance(analysis, facs_report_appearance(params), params$appearance_file)
plots <- plot_facs_quantitation(analysis, appearance = style, signal = params$signal)
page <- assemble_facs_panels(plots, ncol = min(2L, length(plots)),
                             layout_options = style$layout_options)
bundle <- build_facs_figure_bundle(analysis, style, seed = 1)
facs_report_save_artifacts(analysis, bundle, params$output_analysis_rds,
                           params$output_figure_bundle_rds, params$overwrite)
```

## Signal quantitation

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6
quantitation_names <- setdiff(names(plots), "gate_assignment")
for (name in quantitation_names) print(plots[[name]])
```

## Plot-ready tables

```{r}
if (analysis$config$plot_type == "ph3") {
  analysis$quantitation$ph3
} else {
  analysis$quantitation$by_signal[[params$signal]]
  canonical_edu_tables <- c(
    "edu_assigned_phase_composition",
    "edu_single_cells_phase_composition",
    "edu_six_gate_phase_composition",
    "edu_regional_positivity",
    "edu_overall_positivity",
    "edu_positive_cell_regional_intensity",
    "edu_positive_population_intensity"
  )
  analysis$quantitation[canonical_edu_tables]
  analysis$quantitation[paste0(canonical_edu_tables, "_acquisition")]
}
```
